_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Verus telemetry (Component 2). PINNED / CI / non-dev config. Unlike the dev-default .mcp.json (which expects a running hot-reload HTTP server), this registers verus as a stdio server launched by the self-provisioning script .claude/bin/verus-mcp, which installs and execs a PINNED release of verus-tools-mcp. Use this on the box, in CI, or for colleagues who do not hack on the server. To make it active: rename or symlink this file to .mcp.json (e.g. `ln -sf .mcp.prod.json .mcp.json`), or otherwise select it as the active Claude Code MCP config. See .claude/hooks/README.md.
